title: Valid GMM Inference with Non-parametrically Generated Discrete Type
abstract: arXiv:2610.42052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The recent progress in machine learning and classification methods has enabled researchers to predict economic discrete attributes that are not observed in standard datasets. These range from missing demographics, such as ethnicity and poverty status, to economic categories, such as innovative firms, metropolitan areas, occupational groups, binary treatment status, and counterfactual status. Although the plug-in procedure is widely used in empirical applications, nonparametric first-stage estimation recovering the labels can introduce regularization bias because of its slow convergence rate. Even if the double/debiased machine learning approach provides a way to correct the regularization bias, the according bias-correction term is not well defined in our problem, because even a small first-stage error can change the type discontinuously. To address this problem, we smooth the discontinuous type indicators using a smooth kernel function

translated_title: 具有非参数生成离散类型的有效GMM推断
translated_abstract: 机器学习和分类方法的最新进展使研究人员能够预测标准数据集中未被观测到的经济离散属性。这些属性涵盖缺失的人口统计信息，如种族和贫困状况，也包括经济类别，如创新型企业、大都市区、职业群体、二元处理状态以及反事实状态。尽管插件法在实证应用中被广泛使用，但用于恢复标签的非参数第一阶段估计可能因其缓慢的收敛速度而引入正则化偏差。即使双重/去偏机器学习方法提供了一种纠正正则化偏差的途径，但相应的偏差校正项在我们所研究的问题中定义并不明确，因为即使是很小的第一阶段误差也会不连续地改变类型。为了解决这一问题，我们使用平滑核函数来平滑不连续的类型指标
tldr: 针对机器学习生成的离散类型会导致不连续变化、使双重去偏机器学习的偏差校正项失效的问题，本文提出用平滑核函数平滑不连续的类型指标，从而实现有效的GMM推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes smoothing the discontinuous type indicators with a smooth kernel function to achieve valid GMM inference when discrete types are non-parametrically generated, addressing the failure of standard double/debiased machine learning bias-correction caused by discontinuous type changes.
